scope: single bilinear graph q=dT*phi over symmetric thrust-attitude box
interpretation: For one bilinear term on a rectangle, McCormick is support-exact because it is the convex hull of the bilinear graph.
The independent q-box is strict only in sign-incompatible joint directions.
Pure horizontal output direction has zero gap, so correlation preservation alone does not reduce the one-step vx support in this minimal model.
Further gain must exploit nonrectangular SMF domains, shared products across stages, or other structure.
